text:
Priya K: Quick check — for the May 12 product roundtable we want a 'seating map' on the reg page so we can limit participants per breakout (20 max each). Can someone confirm if HubSpot can pass a preferred breakout field into Zoom registration?

Diego R: HubSpot -> Zoom mapping: yes, but we need to surface the custom field on the reg form. I can add `preferred_breakout` as a hidden property that we sync to Zoom. Need to confirm the exact field name we use for routing.

Ava M: Love that — also we should add a required "role" dropdown (PM / Eng / Other) so panels are balanced. Does that break any GDPR consent flow? @Liam S? :thinking_face:

Liam S: GDPR ok as long as consent checkbox is explicit and we keep it for 30 days by default. We'll add `consent_registration` checkbox and a short privacy blurb.

Priya K: Great. Zoom recording plan: start at host join, stop on host leave, and auto-upload cloud recording to our S3 bucket with folder `roundtables/may-12`. @EventBot can you confirm the upload hook exists? :robot_face:

EventBot: Zoom cloud recording webhook configured. Payload posts to /events/zoom-recording with `event_type: recording.completed`. Path: s3://redwood-inference-recordings/roundtables/may-12/ (includes chat.txt + transcript.vtt).

Diego R: For clip ownership & post-event sequencing — plan: 1) auto-transcribe, 2) generate 3x 90s highlight clips via `clipper` job, 3) upload clips to Content Drive and ping #marketing with links. We should also create a HubSpot workflow to send the 90s clip + replay link to registrants at 24h.

Ava M: Minor ops note: ensure the `clipper` uses speaker metadata so titles are like "Product roadmap highlight — {speaker}". Also add captions burned-in for social drafts.

Priya K: Can we add an on-demand cadence: immediate replay email with full recording (72h expiry link), 24h highlight email (90s), and 7-day nurture that drips a 3-part recap (clips + short blog)? Need owners.

Diego R: I can own HubSpot workflow and the 24h send. @Ava M can own clip creation and social drafts. @Liam S will confirm recording retention and links. I'll open the workflow ticket after this thread.

Ava M: I'll add a small production checklist in Notion: preflight reg page (seat map + role field), Zoom host checklist (recording settings, co-hosts, spotlight), post-event clip steps (transcript QC, 3 clips, captions). Will link in channel. :white_check_mark:

Priya K: Perfect. Two action items before Friday: Diego to confirm field sync name + HubSpot workflow draft, Ava to create Notion checklist and assign clip owner. Ping here when done. Thanks! :raised_hands:
